<section className="article-section">

<h2 id="representations-and-retrieval"><a href="#representations-and-retrieval">Representations and retrieval<span className="heading-hash" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a></h2>

<p>In a vector-retrieval system, stored representations make it possible to rank candidate matches to a query. Similarity is a retrieval signal; it is not, by itself, proof that a result is correct or appropriate for a downstream task.</p>

<p>ABI’s README associates WDBX with semantic storage and hybrid ranking. For exact interfaces and the Current/Partial/Proposed mapping, use the upstream source and specification rather than treating this overview as an SDK reference.</p>

</section>

<section className="article-section">

<h2 id="persistence-is-not-implicit"><a href="#persistence-is-not-implicit">Persistence is not implicit<span className="heading-hash" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a></h2>

<p>The README describes code paths that attempt configured storage and notes that persistence can be disabled, skipped, unavailable or unsuccessful. A system must distinguish those outcomes instead of fabricating a successful write.</p>

<p>For example, the documented environment values ABI_WDBX_PERSIST=0 and ABI_WDBX_PATH=:memory: opt out of durable persistence for relevant paths. Check the source for the exact command behavior before applying an override to your application.</p>

</section>

<section className="article-section">

<h2 id="what-coverage-means"><a href="#what-coverage-means">What reported coverage means<span className="heading-hash" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a></h2>

<p>The README reports contract coverage for ordered search results, metadata round trips, segment/WAL recovery and compaction, temporal graph snapshot restoration, and MCP hybrid ranking. That is an upstream report; these tests were not rerun for this website.</p>

<p>It does not establish arbitrary scale, deployment topology, compliance, encryption guarantees or throughput. This review includes no connected database and no simulated query results presented as live output.</p>

</section>
